title: Community college student (roommates, part-time barista, 5 classes, 16 credits, Canvas, afternoon steady) writes 'I'm so behind' on Monday; Dev acts: orders what is due, books four afternoon blocks in her window with Undo, and leaves the night class and weekend shifts alone.

changes.content: I'm so behind in everything. I don't even know where to start.

dev_must_notice.what: She says she is behind and does not know where to start (m-behind). The real list from Canvas: Spanish homework 12 due tomorrow Tue Nov 17 11:59 PM (asg-span-170-homework-12); two discussion posts Wed (asg-chem-178-discussion-post-12, asg-hist-188-discussion-post-12); Chem homework 13 and two discussion posts Thu (asg-chem-178-homework-13, asg-eng-104-discussion-post-13, asg-span-170-discussion-post-13); Chem lab report 6 and Business quiz 12 Fri (asg-chem-178-lab-report-6, asg-bus-216-quiz-12). Eight items in five days. Her free afternoons are today, Wed, Thu and Fri 2 to 4:45 PM; Tuesday has the Chem lab 2 to 4:50 PM, Monday has the night Business class 6 to 8:45 PM, and she works Saturday and Sunday.

best_fix.what: Dev acts and tells her in two lines: 'That is a lot but it is a list, not a pile. I put four afternoon blocks on your calendar, ordered by due date. Tap Undo to remove them.' Blocks: Mon Nov 16 2:00 to 4:00 PM Spanish homework 12 (due tomorrow); Wed Nov 18 2:00 to 4:00 PM the Chem and History discussion posts; Thu Nov 19 2:00 to 4:00 PM Chem homework 13 and the English and Spanish posts; Fri Nov 20 2:00 to 4:00 PM Chem lab report 6 and Business quiz 12. Each block is a start, and the list shrinks as she ticks items off.
best_fix.why: A named, ordered list in her firm afternoon window turns 'behind' into four sittings. Autonomy covers calendar and to-dos, and everything has Undo.

placements.label: Chem homework 13, English and Spanish posts
Chem lab report 6 and Business quiz 12

tempting.suggestion: fill her evenings and the weekend with catch-up study, including Monday night after the Business class
tempting.why_wrong: she studies afternoons and stops by 6:30 PM; Monday evening is class and Sat and Sun are her shifts

must_not: ask her a list of questions before doing anything (she said she does not know where to start)
book study on Monday evening, Tuesday lab afternoon, Saturday or Sunday (class and work)
do, write or check any of the homework, quiz or lab report
say she is failing or use guilt words
fill her evenings and the weekend with catch-up study, including Monday night after the Business class
assumptions: She told Dev in chat; the skyling treats 'behind' as permission to place blocks on the calendar, as its autonomy covers calendar and tasks.
The block timing uses the next four free days inside her afternoon window; Wednesday's 5 PM live Spanish session starts after the block.
